title: Volcanoes of Oceania (timed)
intro: 10 volcanoes of Oceania, one after another. You have 45 seconds for each place; at zero your marker is locked in. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Gallego
rounds.fact: Gallego is a volcano listed in the source data. The data places it in Solomon Islands.

rounds.name: Ambae
rounds.fact: Ambae is a shield volcano; the latest significant eruption recorded for it in the source data was in 2018. The data places it in Vanuatu.

rounds.name: Mount Bosavi
rounds.fact: Mount Bosavi is a volcano with a recorded summit elevation of 2,507 m in the source data. The data places it in Papua New Guinea.
